Timesact Pre-order — feature guide

Keep this guide open next to the app while you work. Each section covers what a feature does, when to use it, where to click, and a real screenshot from the app. Click any screenshot to enlarge it. All screenshots come from a live test store; no settings were changed.

The app is built on three things

Customer Experience
A rule set: what to show (pre-order, notify me, coming soon, low stock), how to charge, when to ship, and how the button and badge look.
Products / Variants
Which products or variants the experience applies to. Add them manually, by CSV, or with a Shopify tag. Each variant has its own status.
Shopify selling plan
Turning on pre-order makes Timesact create a Shopify "purchase option" (selling plan). Checkout, discounts, deposits and fulfillment holds all run through it.
1 · EmbedTurn on the Timesact app embed in the theme
2 · ExperienceCreate one from a template
3 · SettingsPayment, shipping, discount, stock
4 · StorefrontButton, message, badge, timer, cart
5 · ProductsAssign variants, schedule, limits
6 · NotifyPublish emails, Klaviyo
7 · TrackOrder tags, analytics

1Home and setup

The first page you see when you open the app. It shows whether setup is complete, your plan limit, and performance.

What's here

  • Setup guide: 3 steps — enable in theme, personalize the experience, add products. This store is 3/3 complete.
  • Plan alerts: get notified as you approach the plan limit (optional).
  • Plan and usage: orders used so far, plus "Change plan".
  • Theme status: whether the Timesact app embed is on. "Manage in theme editor" takes you to the theme.
  • Performance: pre-order items sold, revenue, Notify Me signups, sold-out products (with a date range).
  • Need a hand?: chat, book a setup call, help center.
Before you start: make sure Theme status is "Enabled". If it's off, no button or badge will appear on the storefront.
Under the hood: everything on the storefront is injected by a theme app embed (a JS widget). It has to be turned on under Theme editor → App embeds.

2Templates (14)

Templates live under the Experiences menu. "Use template" creates an experience with settings pre-filled, which you then adjust. You can also build one from scratch with "Create Customer Experience".

🛒

Pre-order CORE

Keep taking orders when a product sells out; ship when stock is back.

🛎️

Pre-order & Notify Me CORE

Take pre-orders while slots last, then collect emails.

✉️

Notify Me CORE

Email form on out-of-stock products; email customers on restock.

📣

Coming Soon & Notify Me CORE

Announce an upcoming product and collect emails before launch.

⏳

Low Stock CORE

Show "only X left" urgency when inventory runs low.

🙈

Hide Sold Out Add-on Storewide

Hide sold-out products across the store and bring them back on restock.

💵

Pre-order deposit & pay on fulfillment PRO

Deposit at checkout, remaining balance when the order ships.

🌍

Pre-order by Market PRO

Pre-orders only in chosen markets; sell normally everywhere else.

🔔

Back in Stock CORE

Alert customers automatically the moment a product is restocked.

📦

Backorder CORE

Keep selling after stock runs out; fulfill when new inventory arrives.

🗓️

Coming Soon CORE

Inactive "Coming Soon" button before launch.

🛠️

Made to Order CORE

Made after ordering, with production and shipping timelines.

📋

Storewide Waitlist PRO Storewide

Automatic waitlist on every sold-out product, no product setup needed.

🚀

Pre-order Launch CORE

Take orders before release; start shipping on a set launch date.

Pre-order, Backorder and Made to Order work the same way. Only the default button and badge text differ.

3Experience editor

Click the pencil (✏️) icon under "Customer Experiences in use" to open the editor. The left menu has Functionality, Admin (4 sections) and Storefront (4 sections).

Functionality — several features in one experience

"Add functionality" lets you combine several features in one experience:

  • Purchase: Pre-order, Backorder, Made to Order
  • Notification: Back in Stock, Notify Me, Waitlist
  • Availability: Coming Soon
  • Urgency: Low Stock

For example, Pre-order + Notify Me together shows both buttons when stock hits 0, so the customer can choose.

The "Done editing? → Add products" banner reminds you to assign products after you finish the settings.

4Functionality settings

Editor → Admin → Functionality settings. When pre-order shows, how payment is taken, when it ships, and when stock is reduced — all here.

Purchase option

OptionWhat happens
Use Shopify purchase option currentSupports split payments, scheduled charges and discounts. Gift cards and Buy X Get Y do not work.
Don't use a Shopify purchase optionGift cards and BXGY work, but split payments and pre-order discounts are turned off.

When Pre-order shows

OptionWhen to use
Only when out of stock currentStandard pre-order. Replaces Sold out when stock hits 0; Add to cart returns when stock is back.
Always, whatever the stock levelLaunches and drops. Always shows Pre-order, unlimited or with your own limit.
Only while Shopify stock lastsSell incoming stock as "pre-order". Becomes Sold out at 0.

Shipping and fulfillment

  • As soon as possible: no date. Leaving {{shippingDate}} in the message shows "variable_not_set".
  • Exact date: one date for everyone.
  • A set time from checkout current: 7 Days: X days/weeks/months after the order.
  • A time range from checkout: e.g. 4–6 weeks.

Shopify sets the fulfillment status from the shipping schedule: the order stays On hold during the shipping window.

Shipping is 7 days, but the message says "as soon as available". They don't match — see section 14.

Billing, pricing, stock, continue selling

SettingOptions
BillingFull amount current / Split payment — first charge (amount or %), the rest later. A first charge of 0 takes nothing now (0-down). CORE Flex
PricingNo discount current / Fixed amount off / Percentage off
When to reduce stockWhen the order is placed current (stock drops immediately and can go negative) / When the order is fulfilled
Continue sellingWhile pre-order is active, Shopify's "Continue selling when out of stock" is turned on automatically and off afterwards On
The split-payment balance can be charged on a set date, X days after checkout, or on fulfillment PRO. Automatic charging needs Shopify Payments or PayPal Express.

5Markets, notifications, tag automation

Markets & locations

  • Market: Global current / Specific countries PRO / Shopify Markets PRO
  • Inventory: All locations current / Specific locations PRO — which warehouses count toward stock

Notifications (per experience)

Built-in notifications current (Timesact sends the emails) or Klaviyo (sent through your Klaviyo flows).

Tag automation

  1. Enter a new, unique tag (case-sensitive), e.g. preorder-fw26, and save.
  2. Add that tag to any product in Shopify. It joins the experience automatically.
  3. Remove the tag and the product leaves the experience automatically.
  4. Manually added products stay regardless of tags (manual takes priority).
Use this instead of manual adds when you have many products. No tag is set in this store yet.

6Product page (storefront)

Editor → Storefront → Product page. What the customer sees on the product page: button, message, badge, timer.

Button

  • Default (theme style) / Custom current
  • Separate text for Pre-order, In-stock and Sold-out
  • Width/height (px or %), corner rounding, border, font size/weight/style, text/background/border colors
  • Live preview at the top
Currently font weight is 100 (very thin) and the in-stock text is "Pre-order". A 500–600 weight and "Add to Cart" would be better.

Message + smart variables

Text shown above or below the button. Variables for live data:

VariableShows
{{inventoryQuantity}}Current stock
{{preorderQuantity}}Pre-order slots left
{{daysLeftUntilEndDate}}Days until the end date
{{shippingDate}}Estimated shipping date

Also: placement (below/above button), font, alignment, color.

Example: Ships by {{shippingDate}} · only {{preorderQuantity}} left

Badge

  • Enable toggle Enabled
  • Text ("Pre-Order") and type (Rounded …)
  • Position: Top/Bottom × Left/Right
  • Font size, text color, background

Timer (countdown)

  • Title, subheading, labels (Days/Hrs/Mins/Secs)
  • Type: Countdown to a date / Countdown for a fixed time
  • Start: immediately / at a specific time later
  • End date + what happens when it ends (e.g. hide)
  • Colors, border, padding, margin
The timer currently says "Hurry up! / Sale ends in:" and the labels contain sample numbers ("10 Days"). For pre-orders use "Pre-order closes in:" and plain labels like "Days".

7Collection page and cart page

Collection page

  • Button (Default/Custom), text: Pre-Order / Add to Cart / Sold Out
  • Message
  • Badge Disabled — shows on a product card only when every variant is on pre-order

Cart label

Text under pre-order items in the cart. Currently: "Pre-order item delivers as soon as available."

Cart alert pop-up Disabled

  • Title, message (policy agreement), "I agree" button, "Don't show again"
  • Button colors
  • Trigger: on Pre-order button click / on the cart page

Mixed cart checkout Disabled

  • Pop-up alert (CORE): warns when the cart mixes pre-order and in-stock items
  • Block checkout PRO: prevents checkout for mixed carts (including Shop Pay, Apple/Google Pay)
  1. Shopify Settings → Checkout → Checkout rules → Add rule → Timesact Cart Validation → Active
  2. Turn on "Block checkout…" in Timesact
  3. Edit the checkout message and save
Under the hood: Block checkout is a Shopify Function (cart & checkout validation), so the theme can't bypass it.
Translations: experience text is translated with Shopify Translate & Adapt (or another translation app), because the data is stored in metaobjects.

8Products and variants

Sidebar → Products. Which experience each product/variant uses, its status, schedule and sold count.

List

  • Tabs: All / Pre-order / Back in stock / Coming soon / Low stock / + custom view
  • Change a row's experience from the Customer Experience dropdown
  • Search, filters (functionality, status, experience), "Add Products", "Refresh"
  • On each variant row: Shopify link, 👁 storefront preview, ✏️ variant settings

What the statuses mean

StatusMeaning
Pre-order – On standbyAssigned, but in stock, so it shows the normal Add to cart
Pre-order – ActiveStock is 0; the Pre-order button is showing

Pre-order tab

Extra columns: Pre-order quantity, Pre-order sold, Inventory quantity. Movement Pants Olive / M: 2 sold, inventory -2.

Variant detail (✏️)

  • Assigned experience, status, schedule, limit, sold
  • Schedule: start date, end date toggle (UTC timezone)
  • Pre-order quantity: unlimited toggle or a specific limit
  • Assign a different experience to the variant from the "Customer Experience library"
  • "View on the Online Store"
Each variant can have its own state: M = Add to cart, L = Pre-order, XS = Notify Me.

9Email notifications

Notifications page

  • Custom email domain: send from your own domain (requires DNS access)
  • Pre-order: Confirmation email Draft, Shipping delay email Live, Confirmation SMS Coming soon
  • Notify Me: email Live, SMS Draft

Email editor

  1. Click an email → Preview
  2. "Edit code" to edit the HTML (logo, copy, colors)
  3. "Send test" to send it to yourself
  4. "Publish" to make it Live
The confirmation email is still a Draft, with a "LOGO HERE" placeholder and sample snowboard products. Until it's published, customers get no pre-order confirmation email.

10Analytics

Pre-order

  • Sales (revenue, units, AOV)
  • Top pre-order products
  • Traffic source insights
  • Notifications & email performance
  • Split payment insights

Notify Me / Back in Stock / Waitlist

  • Trends over time
  • Purchase conversion
  • Traffic insights (page → click → subscribe → email)
  • Top Notify Me products
CORE keeps 30 days of data; PRO is unlimited.

11Billing and account

Billing — plans

PlanPriceKey features
Free$020 orders/month, unlimited emails and signups, badges, translation, mixed cart alert
CORE Flex$5 + $0.2/orderSplit payment, deposit, 0-down, CSV, tags, SMS, remove branding
PRO Flex$7 + $0.3/orderMarkets & locations, charge on fulfillment, storewide automation, block checkout, unlimited analytics
CORE FixedFrom $23/moUnlimited orders

Store settings

Store name, domain, contact email/phone, and time zone (currently UTC). Schedules and reports use this time zone.

Integrations

  • Klaviyo: sends pre-order confirmation, back-in-stock and shipping-delay events to Klaviyo
  • Slack: plan usage and limit alerts

Developer settings

Override the theme's CSS selectors for the product page, collection page and quick view. If the button or badge doesn't show on a custom theme, fix it here. "Reset to defaults" is available.

A wrong selector stops Timesact working on the storefront. Don't touch this unless you know CSS/HTML.

12End-to-end flow (verified in this store)

  1. Products were added MANUALLY to the "Pre-orders" experience
  2. Timesact creates a selling plan in Shopify and attaches it to the products as a purchase option
  3. In-stock variants are On standby with the normal Add to cart
  4. Movement Pants hits 0 stock → Active, Pre-order button
  5. A customer orders Olive / M × 2 (test gateway)
  6. Order #1001 gets the Pre-order tag automatically and stays Unfulfilled
  7. Because stock is reduced "when the order is placed", inventory goes to -2 right away
  8. When stock arrives, fulfill it like a normal order

13Step-by-step recipes

How to do the common tasks. Each step tells you which section to go to.

A. Turn on pre-order for sold-out products (basic)
  1. Home → check Theme status is "Enabled" (section 1)
  2. Experiences → Pre-order → Use template (section 2)
  3. Functionality settings → When shows: Only when out of stock; Shipping: a date or X days; Billing: Full amount (section 4)
  4. Product page → button text, message with Ships by {{shippingDate}}, badge on (section 6)
  5. Cart page → mention shipping in the cart label (section 7)
  6. Products → Add Products → select variants (section 8)
  7. Notifications → edit Confirmation email → Send test → Publish (section 9)
  8. Open a sold-out variant on the storefront and check
B. Pre-order with a deposit / split payment CORE Flex
  1. Billing & Account → CORE Flex (or higher) plan
  2. Functionality settings → Purchase option: Use Shopify purchase option
  3. Billing → Split payment → first charge (e.g. 20%) → when to charge the rest (date / X days later / on fulfillment = PRO)
  4. Mention the deposit in the message, e.g. "Pay 20% now, the rest before shipping"
  5. Make sure Shopify Payments / PayPal Express is on (other gateways can't auto-charge)
  6. Track it under Analytics → Split payment insights
C. Collect emails on out-of-stock products (Notify Me)
  1. New experience from the Notify Me template, or Add functionality → Notify Me on an existing one
  2. If combined with Pre-order, keep "Only when out of stock" — both buttons show at 0 stock
  3. Notifications → edit the Notify Me email → Live
  4. Assign variants under Products
  5. Analytics → Trends, Traffic insights, Top Notify Me products
D. Launch a new product (Coming Soon → Pre-order)
  1. Template: Coming Soon & Notify Me — inactive button + email capture before launch
  2. Timer: Countdown to a date = launch date
  3. At launch, switch to the Pre-order Launch template or change the experience to Pre-order (Products dropdown)
  4. The Notify Me list gets emailed; set Shipping = Exact date
E. Add many products at once with a tag
  1. Experience → Tag automation → unique tag (e.g. preorder-fw26) → save
  2. Shopify Products → bulk select → Add tag
  3. Timesact Products → "Refresh" → the products appear
  4. Remove the tag to take a product out
F. Warn or block when pre-order and in-stock items are bought together
  1. Cart page → Mixed cart checkout → Enable mixed cart alert pop-up (CORE)
  2. To block (PRO): Shopify Settings → Checkout → Checkout rules → Timesact Cart Validation → Active
  3. In Timesact turn on "Block checkout…" → edit the message → save
G. The button isn't showing on the theme
  1. Home → Theme status Enabled? If not, "Manage in theme editor" → App embeds → turn Timesact on
  2. Products → is the variant status Active (stock 0 + "Only when out of stock")?
  3. Is the variant's schedule start date in the past?
  4. On a custom theme, fix the selectors (form, add-to-cart button) under Billing & Account → Developer settings, or contact support chat

Storefront checklist (log in with the store password)

  • Movement Pants (stock 0) shows the Pre-Order button, message, badge, timer
  • In-stock products show the normal Add to cart
  • Switching variants updates the button correctly
  • Collection page card
  • Pre-order label in the cart
  • Purchase option text and price at checkout
  • Order gets the "Pre-order" tag, fulfillment On hold
  • Button, badge and timer on mobile

15Limitations

Payment
  • In purchase-option mode, pre-orders can only be paid with Shopify Payments / PayPal Express
  • Gift cards and Buy X Get Y don't work
  • Automatic balance charges depend on provider support
Channels
  • Doesn't work on POS, B2B checkout or draft orders
  • Shop App / social channels don't show pre-order terms
  • Doesn't work with bundles
Other apps
  • May conflict with subscription/selling plan apps (e.g. Appstle) on the same product
Theme
  • Custom/headless themes may need selectors in Developer settings
  • Nothing shows if the app embed is off

Sources: the live app screens (03 Oct 2026), Timesact Help Center, App Store listing.
